name: footer-sitemap
title: Footer Sitemap
description: A dense sitemap footer with five to seven link groups that fold into disclosures on a narrow box, and a region picker.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence about the site, under the brand.

props.name: groups
props.description: The link groups, in order. Five to seven read best.

props.name: regions
props.description: Regions or languages, as links. Left out, the picker is left out.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Width of the footer's box, in px, below which the groups fold. Default 640.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Groups that start open when folded. Default none.

props.name: labels
props.type: { heading?: string; regions?: string; newTab?: string }

a11y.text: A footer with a screen-reader-only h2 and a group per h3. On a wide footer the groups are open lists. On a narrow footer the h3 holds a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls that opens a labelled region. The region nav (default "Region and language") marks the current one with aria-current="true" and sets hrefLang and lang.
On a narrow footer each group heading is a button.
Opening a group fades it in and lifts it 6 px over 240 ms; under reduced motion (MotionConfig reducedMotion="user") the lift is dropped and the fade remains. The height changes at once.
Groups fold by the width of the footer itself (collapseBelow, default 640) and start open before it is measured.
